verdict.rationale: Superset ships an official CLI (`superset`), a single static binary that drives the same backend as the desktop app. It manages workspaces, tasks, automations and the local host server from a terminal or CI, and the `superset:orchestrate` skill uses it so one agent can coordinate worker agents. The CLI docs page is confirmed by probe. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, and a documented command reference beyond the getting-started overview.
